constraints.source: I can't do reading during the day, only at night is fine.
constraints.paraphrase: Never schedule reading between 07:00 and 18:00; only in the evening/night.

questions: What hours count as "during the day" for you? I assumed 07:00 to 18:00, so reading would only be placed after 18:00.
